facts.fact: The Office of the Head of the Local Government Service signed an MoU with Celltel Networks on 3 September 2026 to start a nationwide programme, LITISIP, to build the digital infrastructure for Ghana's 261 metropolitan, municipal and district assemblies; no assembly is said to be connected yet.
facts.system: Local Government Service IT Infrastructure and Systems Improvement Programme (LITISIP)

facts.fact: LITISIP is a programme of the Office of the Head of the Local Government Service, with Celltel Networks as private partner under an MoU of 3 September 2026 and Cisco named by Celltel as a backer.
facts.system: Local Government Service IT Infrastructure and Systems Improvement Programme (LITISIP)

facts.fact: The Head of the Local Government Service presented LITISIP on 3 September 2026 as the programme to give the 261 assemblies a secure digital backbone, going beyond 'connecting offices'; the article gives no cost or timetable for it.
facts.system: Local Government Service IT Infrastructure and Systems Improvement Programme (LITISIP)

facts.fact: The article on the 3 September 2026 MoU between the Local Government Service and Celltel Networks states no value, budget line or source of finance for LITISIP.
facts.system: Local Government Service IT Infrastructure and Systems Improvement Programme (LITISIP)
